entities.summary: Carlos Mario Quintanar Rohana was a Mexican basketball player and coach from Chihuahua. He was the captain of the senior men's Mexico national basketball team. Quintanar was nicknamed "Aguja", "Pistolitas", and "The Yokohama Sensation". Along with players like Arturo Guerrero, Manuel Raga, and a few others, Quintanar is generally considered to be one of the best Mexican basketball players of all time.
